title: A Portrait for the Verdict
author: Xanthe Voss
blurb: Odile Halloran, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
